summary: A 2024 proposal describing the Business, Technology and Community groups, independent governance responsibilities and a proposed allocation of Bittrees, Inc. revenue.

snapshot.title: BIP1: Financial Flow and Organization Summary update
snapshot.body:
The Operations Team at Bittrees, Inc. is proposing a financial strategy that is more sustainable and equitable in response to this Demand for a Proposal: https://metaforo.io/g/bittreesinc/thread/demand-for-a-proposal-51706

Summary of Bittrees, Inc:
Bittrees, Inc was founded March 27th, 2020 as a metaverse company, built on the following philosophy. The organization was divided into three sectors, Business, Technology, and Community, whereas each is assigned one individual to lead. 

The Community sector focuses on engagement initiatives while being a point of contact for potential partnership opportunities and other referrals from contributors. This sector delegated their business processes responsibility to the Business sector. 

The Business sector anticipates and listens to the needs of the Community sector. The Business sector standardizes processes and creates templates and tools to the benefit of the Community sector. As processes are standardized and used, proposals are made to the Technology sector to help automate certain functions. The business leader delegates their executive function to the operations team who ensure processes stay on track and each group and team has their needs accounted for. 

The Technology sector acts on behalf of Bittrees to create and maintain technology stacks and other digital systems or contracts which fit the perceived needs and requirements delegated to them by the Community and Business sectors. 

In this manner we can harmonize these three groups, and the resources and tools generated by any one sector benefits the whole all while working together towards a number of goals and initiatives.

Our long term goal has been to develop and make available resources and tools that can be used as public goods. To support this goal, we have medium and short term strategies that range between revenue generating and community engagement opportunities.

Proposal:
TLDR: Below are several proposed changes and updates concerning the financial flow and organization summary of Bittrees, Inc, and its partners organizations. The most significant of these proposals include a revised financial strategy taken by Bittrees, Inc and a new governance model for the Business, Technology, and Community sectors. Instead of being led by a single individual, each sector will now be overseen by subDAOs with leaders elected from within.

Independent Entities and Token Voting Rights:
Bittrees Research and Bittrees Capital are and function as autonomous organizations, each entrusted with specific responsibilities by Bittrees, Inc. Bittrees Research handles research and debt management, while Bittrees Capital is tasked with managing social credit. It's essential to maintain distinct governance boards for Bittrees, Inc., Bittrees Research, and Bittrees Capital to ensure that governance and financial risks are appropriately distributed, managed, and segregated.

Bittrees Research is a private research organization, directed by its members. Proposal submission and voting rights are exclusive to members, with voting weight tied to the quantity of BRGOV certificates held. 1 BRGOV can be purchased with 1000 BTREE or 0.001 WBTC. BRGOV certificate holders have limited voting rights on budgetary proposals. Bittrees Research has a member elected Board of Trustees who have the final say on proposals and represent the interest of its members. The governance forum can be found in the Member Portal: https://research.bittrees.org/members

Bittrees Capital is tasked with managing the BTREE token release, adhering to a predetermined formula that reflects the contributions and roles of individuals within Bittrees, Inc. and the B.T.C. Groups. This formula incorporates a deflationary mechanism, essential for maintaining the token's utility. This distribution schedule can be found here: Time Distribution Schedule for BTREE: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1YmGBjK4RWfvfLuwSD5oE1iGPf27C9JkM8elWXXZ05yA/edit?usp=sharing

Bittrees, Inc is overseen by a Board of Directors tasked with implementing strategies made by proposals and for ensuring the organization operates smoothly, providing contributors with essential resources for success, whether their endeavors are private or public. Members of The Board of Directors are elected by BGOV certificate holders for 18-month terms. The composition of the board includes an even distribution of seats among leaders from the BTC groups, with one additional seat reserved for the current Chair of Bittrees Research. All official discussion relating to governance decisions can be found at the Governance Forum: https://metaforo.io/g/bittreesinc

Operational Governance - B.T.C. Group:
Bittrees, Inc shall set up three subDAOs: Business, Technology, Community, referred to as the B.T.C. Group. Each of these groups will elect leaders from their respective contributors to serve on governance boards. Each governance board is responsible for the budgetary requirements, initiatives, proposals, contributors, and partners of each respective group. To maintain a unified governance approach, a Business Operations team member will be appointed to the boards of the Technology and Community groups, while the Secretary to the Board of Directors at Bittrees, Inc. will occupy a position on the Business Board. Each group is required to appoint a minimum of three leaders to its board, ensuring operational consistency and promoting a harmonious and effective management style throughout the organization. These groups may request additional members from the Business Operations team who can bring essential support and alignment.

Proposal for the Financial Strategy:
The revenue that enters Bittrees, Inc is earmarked for 3 separate categories:
1) B.T.C. Group: One-third of revenue is evenly distributed among the B.T.C. group, ensuring each Business, Technology, and Community groups receives a one-third share of the allocated category.
2) BRGOV Certificates: One-third of revenue is invested in acquiring BRGOV certificates, this enables Bittrees, Inc. to engage in a limited governance capacity within Bittrees Research, mainly voting on budgetary proposals.
3) Extra Funds: The remainder of the revenue is allocated to 'Extra' funds, establishing a flexible financial pool for financing new initiatives, proposals, or strategic investments, as dictated by the votes and proposals of BGOV holders.

summary: A 2024 proposal to confirm initial BGOV voting eligibility, role thresholds, proposal access, voting timing, quorum and encrypted-choice settings.

snapshot.title: BIP0: Confirming Initial Snapshot Parameters
snapshot.body:
Setting up the snapshot required us at Binc to make decisions without consent of our BGOV holders, we would like to confirm the following:

1) Voting restricted to BGOV holders
   a) The following is the token contract: 
   0x6573248d7A8E18807cBbc6d574C9c21c044c84d1

   2) The following are the role thresholds based on BGOV holdings:
   a) Partner - 420 BGOV
   b) Junior Partner - 210 BGOV
   c) Associate - 69 BGOV

3) Proposals are restricted to Partners at launch; this will be gradually opened to Junior Partners, and then Associates

4) Voting Delay is 7 Days

5) Voting Period is 7 Days

6) Quorum threshold is set at 1260 BGOV

7) Privacy is 'Shutter' : " Choices are encrypted and only visible once the voting period is over"

Please join the discussion in the Bittrees Community chat
